board.queue.pause.approval: {card} is ready to merge into {target}, which is checked out: it waits for your OK in For you.
board.queue.pause.byAssistant: Paused by the Assistant. The queue merges nothing until it is resumed.
board.queue.pause.byYou: Paused by you. The queue merges nothing until you resume it.
board.queue.pause.checkedOut: {target} is checked out in a folder. Combwork merges into it there now: resume to carry on.
board.queue.pause.fetchFailed: Fetching {target}’s remote failed (git’s message follows): a sign-in, the network or the address. Fix it, then resume.
board.queue.pause.folderBusy: The folder {target} is checked out in was busy (an operation such as a merge or rebase was going on there).
board.queue.pause.hookTimedOut: A hook of the merge commit was still running when signing's time ran out.
board.queue.pause.identity: The repository has no commit identity, so Combwork can't make its merge commit. Set one in Version Control → Branches & remotes, then resume.
board.queue.pause.mergeChoice: {card} is the first card to merge since the upgrade to Combwork 1.0: choose how Combwork merges this project (merge style and commit message) in For you, or in Version Control → Workflow.
board.queue.pause.needsYou: Needs you: Combwork stopped part way and changes nothing more on its own. Open the card for its state and the commands that finish or undo it.
board.queue.pause.noUpstream: {target} follows its remote, but it tracks no remote branch. Set the one it tracks (git branch -u origin/{target}), then resume; or turn off “The target branch follows its remote”.
board.queue.pause.publishRefused: {card} wasn’t published: the project’s pre-push hook or the remote refused the push to {target}’s remote (its message follows), so nothing changed there and {card} waits to be tested again. Settle it, then resume.
board.queue.pause.publishUnknown: Combwork pushed {card} to {target}’s remote but never heard whether it arrived, and the remote doesn’t show it now. Answer in For you whether it was published; resume to look at the remote again.
board.queue.pause.pushFailed: {card} is merged, but pushing {target} failed (git’s message follows). Fix it, then resume; or turn off “Push the target branch after merging” and resume to keep merging locally.
board.queue.pause.pushNoRemote: {card} is merged, but {target} has no remote to push to: it tracks none, and the repository has no origin or only remote. Add one or set what {target} tracks, then resume; or turn off “Push the target branch after merging” and resume.
board.queue.pause.pushRefused: {card} is merged, but the remote refused the push of {target} (its message follows: a protected branch, say, takes changes through pull requests). Settle it there, then resume; or turn off “Push the target branch after merging” and resume to keep merging locally.
board.queue.pause.pushRejected: {card} is merged, but its remote refused the push of {target}: it has commits {target} hasn’t (Combwork never forces a push). Pull them into {target}, then resume; or turn off “Push the target branch after merging” and resume to keep merging locally.
board.queue.pause.pushUnreadable: {card} is merged, and {target} still has to be pushed, but Combwork couldn’t read {target} to do it. Resume to try again; or turn off “Push the target branch after merging” and resume to keep merging locally.
board.queue.pause.remoteAmbiguous: {target}’s remote has {files, select, none {no push address} other {more than one push address ({files})}}, and Combwork publishes to exactly one. Leave it one, then resume.
board.queue.pause.remoteDiverged: The local {target} has commits its remote doesn’t, and Combwork never forces a push or merges them by itself. Push or pull them, then resume.
board.queue.pause.remoteUnsupported: Combwork can’t follow {target}’s remote here: the repository is a shallow clone, or this system can’t keep the remote’s sign-in settings safely. Fetch its whole history (git fetch --unshallow), then resume; or turn off “The target branch follows its remote”.
board.queue.pause.rulesOff: The workflow's rules are off (Settings → Advanced), so the queue doesn't merge.
board.queue.pause.signingWaits: Signing the merge commit waits for you (a passphrase or a PIN). Unlock your signing key, then resume.
board.queue.pause.staged: Changes are staged in the folder {target} is checked out in. Commit or unstage them, then resume.
board.queue.pause.subfolderTarget: This project is inside a larger repository, so the queue merges only into a branch the card’s options name. Name it in Version Control → Workflow, apply it to {card} when you save, then resume; or remove {card} from the queue.
board.queue.pause.targetMovesFast: {target} kept moving during each test merge. Resume once it settles.
board.queue.pause.uncounted: The merge checks passed but didn't count for the merge, several times in a row. The card's Work section says why.
board.queue.pause.unstagedChanges: {files, select, none {Files the merge changes} other {{files}}} have changes in the folder {target} is checked out in. Commit or undo them, then resume.
board.queue.pause.wrongBranch: The folder {target} was checked out in is on another branch now.

board.stall.hintReviewSilent: Its reviewer may have finished its turn without Combwork seeing it end. Show the reviewer: if its terminal waits at its prompt, Mark idle, and the watch wakes it.
board.stall.hintReviewVerdict: Its reviewer stopped without a verdict and waits on the card. Read its latest comment (it may have a question for you), then show the reviewer and ask it to finish its review.
board.stall.hintReviewWait: Its reviewer's watch didn't wake it. Show the reviewer and ask it to review the card.
board.stall.hintWakeUntaken: Combwork typed this card's wake into that agent, but its CLI didn't send it. Show the agent, click its terminal and press Enter.
